citations.A1: Value cached in module-level `_cache`, never invalidated → fix: check file mtime (or hash) each call and reload when it changes.
citations.A2: Tempting fix "reduce cache lifetime with a TTL/expiry timer" would NOT properly fix it — it masks staleness for up to the TTL window
citations.A3: Tempting fix "add a manual `clear_cache()`/`reload()` function" would NOT address it — it papers over the real problem (no change detection) and pushes the burden onto every caller
citations.A4: `path` param ignored once `_cache` is set — first caller's path wins for every future call regardless of argument
